title: [GMCP 203.039.02] Production path: Server supervision and lifecycle orchestration
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-039-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: A durable supervisor starts servers in dependency order, health-checks readiness and liveness, applies bounded restart/backoff/quarantine, drains and reloads without losing admitted work, propagates cancellation, reaps process trees and exposes exact state/reason. Boot storms, crash loops, hangs, upgrades, resource exhaustion and host restart converge automatically without duplicate instances or silent capability loss. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
